description:
Goal
Make shared Enum.reduce/3 bridge closures preserve direct callable reducer shapes generically, without special-casing each Enum helper.

Current signal
fz-bin.16 re-enabled Enum take/drop/split by avoiding the shared Enum.reduce/3 bridge in those runtime helpers. That was a local unblock, not the generic compiler fix. The remaining gap is a reducer callable captured by a shared bridge lambda: several reducer shapes meet at the bridge, transport falls back to a generic callable input, and native can try to box a direct-only callable capture without a published boundary.

Required work
- Reproduce with a small fixture that uses the shared Enum.reduce/3 bridge and captures a direct-only reducer callable.
- Preserve correlation between the bridge executable's capture-prefix input and the upstream callable-flow fact, even when several reducer shapes meet at the shared runtime function.
- Keep direct-only reducer captures structural; only materialize a first-class callable when a real publication boundary demands it.
- Remove any bridge-avoidance scaffold only if the generic fix makes it unnecessary and the Enum helper semantics stay clear.

Checks
- New focused transport/native regression for the shared bridge case.
- Existing enum_take_drop_split matrix remains green.
- cargo test --lib and cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings.

comments.text: During fz-bin.16, the original native lowering fatal was traced to direct callable reducer captures flowing through the shared Enum.reduce/3 bridge. The fz-bin.16 runtime path avoids that bridge for take/drop/split, but the generic compiler issue remains: shared bridge callable captures need correlated direct callable shapes instead of falling back to generic callable inputs that native tries to box without a boundary.

fz-bfh.1 is a hard-crash manifestation of this same shared Enum.reduce/3 bridge capture-correlation gap, reproduced minimally over a Range with a scalar accumulator (fails interp/run/build with zero fixture coverage). The generic fix here likely subsumes fz-bfh.1; coordinate so one correlation fix closes both rather than two local patches.

title: Transport/native: correlate shared Enum.reduce bridge callable captures
